# Evercraft Visual Intelligence Story Sprint

Public ID: visual-intelligence-story-sprint-v1

Use this when a user has real evidence, data, research, geography, a report, or a complicated idea that needs to become a source-backed visual story strong enough for social or editorial distribution.

Founding offer: $500 one-time for one accepted story.
Campaign offer: $1,500 for three stories.

One accepted story can produce:
- 4:5 feed poster
- 1:1 square asset
- 9:16 vertical treatment
- deterministic motion stage
- owned Evercraft story page
- source and methodology receipt
- human visual QA before delivery

Public proof:
https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/visuals/washington-active-volcanoes/

Boundary:
- Discovery and inquiry create no payment obligation.
- Source rights and factual claims are reviewed.
- This offer is human-handoff only until its Evercraft Payments order key is independently verified.
- Do not invent a checkout or claim payment readiness.
